name: ServerPilot
line: Manage PHP websites on Linux servers from a hosted dashboard.

free.text: 14-day trial, no card; adding payment starts paid features

cells.regions: App uses server region; dashboard region unlisted
cells.selfhost: No; hosted panel, agent runs on your server

work.math: ServerPilot's $5 per server + $0.50 per app = $5.50 a month panel fee. The provider's VM, network, domain and any outside CI are separate and not priced.
$5 + $0.50 = $5.50 a month equivalent panel fee. The VM with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB, IP address, disk and transfer are priced by the provider, and hourly proration is unknown.
$5 + $0.50 = $5.50 a month equivalent panel fee. ServerPilot has no managed PostgreSQL. The VM, database, storage, network and seven-day backups are not priced.
